Theorem
[Levi-Civita]

↗ def:dc-ch2-3-4 ↗ cor:dc-ch2-3-3 ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-koszul ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-unique ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-welldef ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-exist

1. ch2:3.6Every Riemannian manifold admits a unique affine connection $ abla $ that is

  1. symmetric;

  2. compatible with the Riemannian metric.

Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-unique ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-exist \sketch Metric compatibility applied cyclically gives

\[ X\langle Y,Z angle =\langle abla _XY,Z angle +\langle Y, abla _XZ angle , ag {6} \]

\[ Y\langle Z,X angle =\langle abla _YZ,X angle +\langle Z, abla _YX angle , ag {7} \]

\[ Z\langle X,Y angle =\langle abla _ZX,Y angle +\langle X, abla _ZY angle . ag {8} \]

Adding (6) and (7), subtracting (8), and using symmetry gives

\[ egin{aligned} \langle Z, abla _YX angle = frac 12\{ & X\langle Y,Z angle +Y\langle Z,X angle -Z\langle X,Y angle \ & -\langle [X,Z],Y angle -\langle [Y,Z],X angle -\langle [X,Y],Z angle \} . ag {9} \end{aligned} \]

Thus uniqueness follows from section 2. For existence, take the metric Riesz dual of the right-hand side of (9); its well-definedness and Levi-Civita properties are section 2, section 2.

□
